title: Bitcoin (BTC) 📉 -1.8%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: With Bitcoin down 1.8%, what does this say about its role in the evolving financial ecosystem?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Scalability solutions like Lightning Network are making micropayments viable, but adoption remains uneven.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralization risks in mining pools challenge Bitcoin’s original decentralization promise.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source audits and diverse mining incentives are being actively pursued to mitigate this.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where Bitcoin powers cross-border remittances securely and inclusively is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The path forward demands both innovation and ethical guardrails to shape a fair digital economy.

video_cue: Rapid transitions between blockchain nodes, miners, and global users interacting with Bitcoin wallets.
